title: Schneider Electric IGSS Mobile
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER CERTIFICATE VALIDATION CWE-295 IGSS Mobile app lacks certificate pinning during the TLS/SSL connection establishing process. This issue could allow an attacker to execute a man-in-the-middle attack. CVE-2017-9968 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.4 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N ). PLAINTEXT STORAGE OF A PASSWORD CWE-256 IGSS Mobile app passwords are stored in clear-text in the configuration file. CVE-2017-9969 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.0 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N ). RESEARCHER Alexander Bolshev (IOActive) and Ivan Yushkevich (Embedi) reported these vulnerabilities to Schneider Electric.
